// ==========================================================================
// THE WARDUSTED SET'S PLACEMENT PAGES -- where each gun sits in your hand.
//
// GENERATED by _pending/tools/make_menudef.py from WMCARD.wardusted, alongside that set's
// CVARINFO. Both come off the same card and the same stem rule, so a slider cannot name
// a cvar that does not exist. DO NOT EDIT -- change the card and run it again.
//
// EVERY SLIDER HERE MOVES THE GUN WHILE THE MENU IS OPEN. These are renderer-read cvars;
// a menu freezes the playsim, so a slider on a script-read cvar would move nothing at the
// one moment it is wanted. That is what the LINT-LIVE lines declare and what menu_lint
// checks.
// ==========================================================================

// LINT-LIVE: WM_Place_Wardusted
OptionMenu "WM_Place_Wardusted"
{
	Title "WARDUSTED -- WHERE EACH GUN SITS"
	StaticText "Pick a gun, then drag. It moves in your hand as you drag it.", 1
	StaticText "Put the gun in your hand first -- you are adjusting what you can see.", "DarkGray"
	StaticText ""
	Submenu "WD_DL44", "WM_Place_Wardusted_wd_dl44"
	Submenu "WD_DarkBlaster", "WM_Place_Wardusted_wd_darkblaster"
	Submenu "WD_E22", "WM_Place_Wardusted_wd_e22"
	Submenu "WD_E11", "WM_Place_Wardusted_wd_e11"
	Submenu "WD_Z6", "WM_Place_Wardusted_wd_z6"
	Submenu "WD_DLT19", "WM_Place_Wardusted_wd_dlt19"
	Submenu "WD_Bowcaster", "WM_Place_Wardusted_wd_bowcaster"
